source_import_policy: Standalone process; hash-check frozen source inventory before loading dependencies; run verified frozen launcher.verify only, never execute; load the separate new offline checker with frozen research dependencies.
checks: Require an official FINISHED status, final seal and matching execution claim; stopped and unsealed batches need separate failure handling.
Verify frozen source, inputs, database fingerprint, reference tokenizer and recorded capacity using the original verifier.
Replay the sealed finished batch without model calls or SQL execution.
Archive prepared inputs, frozen source and all results, verify ZIP inventory and every member hash, and preserve separate analysis-source copies.
Never overwrite existing audit output; refuse output nested inside the prepared batch.
Private audit includes actual answer text but console output is compact and ungraded.

validation.real_finished_batch_end_to_end_check: Pending actual execution; not claimed by these tests.

backup_limitations: Local archive, not off-device; external dataset and tokenizer files are not included, only their frozen identities/references.
scientific_status: No new evidence for intent drift or method benefit. Waiting for fixed-batch execution and subsequent human final-answer review.
